evidence_boundaries.ui_evidence: The root and author browser records will be read with scope; independent browser checks will explicitly identify their own coverage.

required_semantics.R: num_ranks, participating expert parallel ranks; rank label R0 is rank index, not rank count
required_semantics.E: num_experts, global expert count, experts per rank E/R
required_semantics.K: num_topk, routing entries per token; invalid -1 differs from destination sentinel
required_semantics.T: num_tokens effective input row count in this invocation, 0<=T<=M; not capacity
required_semantics.M: num_max_tokens_per_rank capacity; all ranks consistent; partitions recv buffer and stride for source global index; not effective T
required_semantics.H: hidden vector element dimension; byte count requires dtype width
required_semantics.A: expert_alignment, output token count aligned separately for each expert, not address byte alignment
required_semantics.C: num_vec_cores teaching label, selected vector cores per rank; 16 is chosen demo and source host lower bound, not universal device maximum
required_semantics.SF: scale-factor packs carried with FP8; sf_pack_t=int16; opaque raw bit patterns, not decoded mathematical scaling factors
required_semantics.gsge: global_sgep_idx within a vector core logical SQE space; *6+sgep; not across entire ranks or literal single SGE index
required_semantics.SQE: send queue entry; dispatch writes logical/physical entries, physical entry is network queue location
required_semantics.SGE: scatter gather entry describing source address and byte length; pair is hidden+metadata
required_semantics.WQEBB: source constant queue granule 64B; dispatch reserved4 differs valid ceil((48+num_sges*16)/64)
required_semantics.signals: teaching aggregation not actual C++ struct; local_copy_ready/metadata_ready UB, arrival field in other status packing
required_semantics.arrival: local rank histogram packed high8 arrival vs low24 data; general arrival status contexts differ
required_semantics.num_unaligned_recv_tokens_per_expert: raw per local expert count excluding per-expert alignment holes
required_semantics.psum_num_recv_tokens_per_rank: inclusive counts per source rank to traverse source partition stream
required_semantics.psum_num_recv_tokens_per_expert: prior aligned counts + current raw count; raw expert end, not conventional all-aligned inclusive sum
required_semantics.recv_src_metadata: K destination expanded slots, global source index, last matching local topk j; cached uses preserved metadata
required_semantics.metadata_send_buffer: metadata contiguous packed bytes separate from hidden; optional SF, weights and fresh topk/global_idx; byte alignment padding remains undefined
required_semantics.epilogue_expert_counter: teaching representation of per-core predecessors count/prefix; not literal allocated symbol
required_semantics.finalFlags: strong order/fence/CQE on last physical SQE; submission still not complete
required_semantics.logicalSQE: lsqe index in per-core logical grouping; differs psqe physical compaction
required_semantics.physicalSQE: psqe in networking SQ; demo one pair/path chosen mapping
required_semantics.hidden: token feature vector payload, opaque transport no MoE computation
required_semantics.weights: routing gate weights copied, no expert weighted sum in dispatch
required_semantics.padding: per-expert hole may zero when enabled; token-layout byte padding undefined must distinguish
required_semantics.handle: cached routing layout; freshness does not imply dynamic arbitrary change of topk
required_semantics.Hcomm: external HCOMM interface/type symbol; full expansion needs verified primary source
required_semantics.AIV: AI Vector, vector core; not invented Ai Vector units count universally
required_semantics.SIMT: single instruction multiple threads; routing/dedup/statistics/SQE paths
required_semantics.UB: Unified Buffer core local scratch storage
required_semantics.GM: Global Memory device memory outside core
required_semantics.DB: doorbell notification submits SQ progression; not data completion

claims: SF carries scale factors in public FP8 input

acceptance: Every visible occurrence of relevant term in all nine presets/stages is bound, not only a glossary or first occurrence.
Definitions identify context and symbol, unit/type/shape/owner/direction, operation/lifecycle/source when applicable.
Repeated source spellings are scoped by file,line/object path and never resolved to a same-name unrelated definition.
Program source textContent equals frozen lines byte for byte.
Hover/focus/click/Escape tooltip works with numeric explanation; modal usable, no opposite tip trapped.
Coverage audits exclude no source/module identifier merely to hide missing glossary entry.
Accurate declaration/type syntax fallback may identify reserved-language keywords; actual variable/function needs meaningful code role.
